subject: Staged purchase lane & procurement portal onboarding — Optima Health renewal and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@optimahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + 15% capacity uplift — procurement next steps

Hi Karthik,

We're planning to renew our Redwood contract for another 12 months and increase committed capacity by ~15% starting 11/01. Procurement has asked that we: 1) confirm the onboarding flow for vendor evidence (SOC2/attestations), 2) confirm how POs should be issued (portal vs email), and 3) whether Redwood supports a staged PO lane (split PO for incremental capacity) to avoid mid-quarter budget rework.

Can you send a short checklist we can give our procurement team and confirm any lead times if we want the uplift active by Nov 1?

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Director, Procurement
Optima Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 15% capacity uplift — procurement next steps

Hi Sara — great to hear the plan. High level: yes, we support a staged PO lane and the ProcureCorp portal integration most enterprise buyers use. I've attached our procurement checklist and a current snapshot of our SOC2 artifacts. Quick answers below and a proposed timeline.

- Evidence: upload SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf + signed attestation to the ProcureCorp portal (we can accept via secure upload or SFTP if your portal has restrictions).
- PO: preferred flow is ProcureCorp portal with PO number entered into the HubSpot deal; we also accept emailed POs to billing@redwood.com if portal onboarding is delayed.
- Staged PO lane: supported. We can map incremental capacity to a secondary PO that applies once the first PO is invoiced; will require both POs to reference the same SOW amendment.

Proposed timeline to hit 11/01 uplift:
- 9/16: confirm procurement contact + portal admin
- 9/20: ProcureCorp portal onboarding (2–3 business days)
- 9/23: PO issued (primary) — initial capacity active immediately upon PO acceptance
- 10/15: secondary PO issued (staged uplift) so billing config for extra capacity completes before 11/01

I attached: procurement-checklist-v2.xlsx and SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf. If you confirm contact for ProcureCorp, I'll loop in our onboarding team to speed the portal enablement.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@optimahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 15% capacity uplift — procurement next steps

Sara — adding onboarding details from our side. A few practical notes for your procurement team:

- Portal uploads: use the "Vendor Evidence" folder in ProcureCorp (we'll provide an invite). Required files: SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf, signed Data Processing Addendum (DPA), and billing contact info.
- SOW amendment: we'll issue a short SOW amendment reflecting the 15% uplift and the two-PO approach. The amendment will include a clause that the secondary PO only triggers the agreed capacity increase and pricing in the master SOW.
- Invoice timing: finance will invoice against the primary PO on acceptance; the staged PO will be invoiced when its effective date is reached.

I'll start the SOW amendment draft and share a DocuSign link for signatures once the PO lanes are confirmed. If your legal/procurement prefer net-45 or a specific invoice remittance address, send that over and Tessa can confirm.

Thanks — Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@optimahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-24T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 15% capacity uplift — procurement next steps

Hi all — quick finance/legal note to keep the schedule intact:

- Invoice terms: our default is net-30. We can accept net-45 for enterprise customers with an approval, but to guarantee the 11/01 capacity activation we need a PO issued for the primary lane by 9/23 and the secondary PO by 10/15.
- Please include the billing contact and remit-to address on the PO; missing fields slow processing.
- Attached is the SOW amendment template I plan to populate (SOW-amendment-optima-2026.docx). Laura — when you have your draft, please send it my way and I will confirm the invoice triggers.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@optimahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 15% capacity uplift — procurement next steps

Thanks everyone — brief update from procurement side: we've routed this to our ProcureCorp team and expect primary PO issued next week (target 10/04). Secondary PO (staged uplift) will be routed after internal approvals and should be with you by 10/14 — aiming to meet the 10/15 trigger you requested. We'll upload the SOC2 snapshot and signed attestation to the portal today.

Forwarding portal onboarding details from ProcureCorp support below — their onboarding team will provision Optima's vendor folder once you (Redwood) confirm the HubSpot deal ID and contact.
